landing_pages.intro:
Chennai is large enough that patients usually start with their own area, their language and the treatment they need, not the whole city.

  • Area-led search: searches name the area, such as Anna Nagar, Velachery or OMR, alongside the treatment.
  • Tamil and English queries: patients search in both languages, and profiles that read well in each are easier to choose.
  • Wider search for specialist care: for IVF, eye surgery or hospital care, patients often look beyond their own area.
  • AI-generated answers: ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews can name clinics, drawing on whatever information is consistent online.

landing_pages.overview:
How we plan: three steps from first audit to patient walk-ins. We audit what you run today, launch channels by locality, then keep refining against walk-ins, not clicks or leads. First you tell us about your clinic — your centres, treatments, targets and the problems you are facing. Then we map the gaps, reviewing your ads, Maps listings, calls and CRM to find where patients drop off. Finally you get a proven plan, scoped to start within 5 km of each centre, with monthly walk-in reviews built in.

No office visit needed — we come to your clinic or hospital. On day one we follow an enquiry from first call to booking at your front desk and map the gaps, then return on an agreed schedule focused on results and front-desk handling. Targets are set around walk-ins and agreed in writing, missed calls trigger an automatic WhatsApp follow-up saved in one patient record, and we use your CRM if it records source and outcome or set up MedLift. We cover Anna Nagar, T. Nagar, Adyar, Velachery, Mylapore, Porur, Vadapalani and the OMR corridor. To plan an onboarding visit, call our team on +91 7428094567.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing company in Chennai for a clinic?
faqs.a: Look at proven results, client success stories, healthcare experience and a portfolio you can check. Then ask how results are reported, because a company that stops at leads cannot show which channel brought patients in. Confirm every ad will carry the doctor's registration details under NMC rules.

faqs.q: How much does a digital marketing company in Chennai charge for a clinic?
faqs.a: Charges depend on the scope of work: how many locations, which channels, and whether call handling and CRM setup are included. Ad spend is a separate decision. Reinvent Digital shares a written scope after reviewing your current marketing, so the cost is clear before you start.

faqs.q: Should a Chennai clinic target its own area or the whole city?
faqs.a: It depends on the treatment. Routine dental care usually works best close to the clinic. Specialist care, such as IVF or eye surgery, can justify wider targeting because patients often travel further for it. Walk-in data then shows where each boundary should sit.

faqs.q: How do AI tools like ChatGPT decide which Chennai clinic to mention?
faqs.a: No one can guarantee a mention. AI tools tend to draw on information that is clear, consistent and repeated across trusted sources. Matching clinic details across your website, Google Maps and directories, plus pages that answer patient questions directly, improves the chance of accurate inclusion.

faqs.q: What happens during the first visit to our Chennai clinic or hospital?
faqs.a: Our team visits your clinic at onboarding and on a regular schedule after that. The first visit traces how an enquiry moves from call or WhatsApp to booking, reviews your Google Maps profiles and checks current campaigns. You see the gaps before anything changes.

faqs.q: What must a multi-speciality hospital in Chennai show on its ads?
faqs.a: Under the NMC guidelines, each ad, post and landing page must name the treating doctors, with their recognised qualifications, registration status and SMR or NMR number. Factual details such as departments, accreditation and emergency services can be shown. Patient testimonials and success rates cannot.
